question: The first Khelo India Winter Games was hosted by which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first Khelo India Winter Games were held in the year 2020.
 
• These games were organized to promote winter sports in India and were held in the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The event featured competitions in various winter sports such as skiing, snowboarding, and ice hockey.
 
• The initiative is part of the larger Khelo India program, which aims to revive the sports culture in India at the grass-root level by building a strong framework for all sports played in our country and establishing India as a great sporting nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Khelo India program was launched in 2018 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• It aims to encourage sports participation and improve the sports infrastructure and ecosystem in India.
 
• The program includes annual sporting events, scholarships for athletes, and the development of sports facilities across the country.
 
• The Khelo India Winter Games are part of this broader initiative to include and promote winter sports.
